observances.name: Phulera Dooj
observances.description: A spring festival of Krishna and Radha, celebrated with flowers, above all in the Braj region (Mathura and Vrindavan); it opens the Holi season and is held to be a lucky day for weddings.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force at sunrise in Ujjain. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Hala Shashthi (Lalhi Chhath)
observances.timing: Kṛṣṇa Ṣaṣṭhī: Shravana in the amānta reckoning, Bhadrapada in the pūrṇimānta (northern) reckoning
observances.description: A fast kept by mothers for their children's long life, honouring Balarama, whose weapon is the plough (hala); food grown in ploughed fields is avoided that day.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force at sunrise in Ujjain. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day. Some traditions keep Balarama's birthday itself on Shravana Pūrṇimā instead.

observances.name: Vamana Jayanti (Vamana Dvadashi)
observances.description: The birthday of Vamana, the dwarf avatar of Vishnu, who won back the three worlds from King Bali in three steps; Vishnu is worshipped at midday.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force at midday in Ujjain. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.

observances.name: Kartika Purnima (Dev Deepawali)
observances.description: The full Moon of Kartika: a holy bath at dawn in a sacred river (Kartika snana), lamps lit on the river banks (Dev Deepawali, the 'Diwali of the gods', at Varanasi), and fairs such as Pushkar.
observances.uncertainty: Dated by calculation: the Hindu month from the Sun's sidereal sign, and the day on which this tithi is in force at sunrise in Ujjain. Local almanacs and communities can differ by a day.
